## About
Summit Auto Body & Painting is a family owned and operated body shop at 317 Old County Rd in Belmont. Auto body repair is our specialty, from fender benders and dings to bigger events.
Our trained and certified technicians start with the skeleton of the car, measuring and correcting any misalignment, then work outward. Paint is mixed by computer for an exact color match and a glossy finish. When the work is done, we clean your car and return it.
We are rated 4.3 from 30 Google reviews. One reviewer told us Chris still remembered a family car he had painted years earlier, down to exactly what was done.

## Services
- Collision repair: From small fender benders and dings to bigger accidents, we put your car back together.
- Bumper repair and replacement: Damaged bumpers repaired or replaced, with paint matched to the rest of your car.
- Dent removal: Dents and dings taken out so the panel looks right again.
- Measure and correct misalignment: After a bigger hit, we measure the car's skeleton and correct any misalignment before the body work begins.
- Computer paint matching: Paint is mixed by computer so new panels blend in with the original color.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We process the claim with the insurance company for you, and we already work with Farmers, State Farm, Mercury, Geico, Progressive, AAA, Esurance, Liberty and others.

Q: How do I get my car to the shop?
A: You can use our 24 hour towing, ask for free pickup, or drive it to us on Old County Rd.

Q: How quickly can I get an estimate?
A: We go over your car and print a computer quote on the spot. One reviewer said they had an estimate within minutes.

Q: How will I get around while my car is being fixed?
A: We can arrange a courtesy ride or a loaner car for you.

## What customers say
- "About two months ago my car got hit from behind (hit&run), and the rear bumper and the reinforcement were badly damaged. I brought it to Summit and they gave me an estimate of the repair cost within minutes.

They were straightforward and let me know that if I was dealing with insurance, the insurance estimate could be lower than theirs, but that in that case they would work with the insurance themselves and figure it out. However when i got the estimate from the insurance it was pretty much exactly the same as the one given by Summit, which was a pleasant surprise.

Once that was settled, they fixed the car in record time and the bumper and reinforcement looked great. I was a little a worried that the new part might stand out because my car is not white or black, but if you looked at the car now you wouldn't be able to tell that any parts were changed.

Overall 10/10 experience, I highly recommend Summit." (Jorge Montolio, 5/5)
